title: Opening integrity repeats identical support-choice prefixes during cold world loading
body:
Cold startup profiling on main 700e523648101f0a684bf5bdaf9d78274e6fd865 measured
22.934ms reading/decoding the world, 98.694ms parsing its schema, and 22007.789ms
checking its integrity. 117 test files call loadOverworldManifest. The profile is
in the sibling audit-playtest-proof worktree at ai-runs/profiles/world-validation.cpuprofile.

assertOpeningDispatchHubIntegrity contributes about 6.7s of inclusive CPU. It
enumerates every subset/permutation of three optional support choices for each
civic prefix, repeatedly evaluating exactly the same ordered prefixes with the
same starting character. Cache those deterministic prefix results locally to
one civic-prefix validation; preserve every compared subset and permutation,
existing runtime validation, and fresh validation on later world edits.

Measure the improvement before adopting it. This touches world integrity and
requires focused regressions, the full health bar, and independent review.
